name: waterlogging-project-root
description: AI-Based Waterlogging Detection and Drainage Advisory System Using Multi-Source Satellite Imagery

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,ML" -c "blue,cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "python -m uvicorn main:app --app-dir ml_service --reload --port 8000"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,ML" -c "blue,cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "python -m uvicorn main:app --app-dir ml_service --port 8000"
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
